SUPPORTED LOG FORMATS

Built for the logs you investigate.

Automatic format detection, structured fields and a raw-text fallback.

CONTAINERS

Kubernetes / CRI

CRI-O-style timestamps, stdout/stderr streams and embedded JSON messages. Pipe kubectl logs into Flik.

WEB SERVERS

Nginx

Common / Combined access logs and Nginx error logs. Inspect requests, HTTP status codes and error severity.

STRUCTURED DATA

JSON / NDJSON

Discover fields, select columns, filter values and inspect nested objects. Open application logs directly.

SYSTEMS

Apache, Syslog & text

Apache access and error formats, traditional Syslog and plain-text logs with search and context.

Custom access-log layouts may use raw-text mode. Timestamp reports include lines with recognized timestamps; missing timestamps are reported separately.

INVESTIGATION FEATURES

From a matching line
to an explainable incident.

Keep the filters, surrounding events and measurements in one keyboard-driven workspace.

01 / SEARCH & FILTER

Narrow the event stream.

Stack include/exclude rules, use regular expressions and combine conditions with AND, OR and NOT. Complete fields and observed values.

(level:error OR status>=500) AND service:payment
02 / FIELD INSPECTION

Read the fields that matter.

Switch between lines and columns. Select JSON fields, inspect distinct values and frequencies, and filter from a selected value.

flik --table --fields timestamp,level,message app.jsonl
03 / ERROR CONTEXT

Keep the surrounding events.

Smart find includes preceding and following lines. Context stays in file order, without duplicates, and is visually distinguished from matches.

//3,2:error
04 / ADAPTIVE STATISTICS

Measure what the log contains.

HTTP status codes for access logs. ERROR, NOTICE and other detected levels for error logs. Inspect frequent IPs, endpoints and errors.

S → select a value → Enter
05 / FREQUENCY & CHANGE

Find when errors recur.

Count the active filter by minute, hour or day. Compare two equal time windows or two files to identify new and disappearing patterns.

histogram hour · compare files
06 / MULTI-FILE WORKSPACE

Follow requests across files.

Open two independent panes, merge matching events chronologically and filter by a correlation ID. Save sessions and export incident context.

trace req-demo-42
Analysis scope is visible.The S dashboard samples up to 5,000 lines. Frequency and comparison reports scan the full indexed source in the background. Context-only lines are excluded from occurrence counts. Times are shown in UTC.

PRACTICAL EXAMPLES

Start with a real task.

Shell commands open the data. Search queries run inside Flik. Investigation commands run in the Ctrl+K prompt.

YOUR EXISTING CLI WORKFLOW

An interactive alternative to repeated jq, grep and tail inspection.

Use Flik for log filtering, field selection, surrounding context and live following. Keep jq for JSON transformations and scripted data processing.

JSON / jqInspect selected fields and filter a service

Move repeated jq field selection and log filtering into an interactive table. Adjust the columns and filters without rerunning the pipeline.

TYPICAL jq FIELD INSPECTION
jq '{timestamp, service, message}' app.jsonl
OPEN AN INTERACTIVE FLIK TABLE
flik --table --fields timestamp,service,message app.jsonl

3 Add the include filter service:payment. Use 6 to change fields and v to inspect a field’s values.

Flik covers interactive JSON log inspection. Keep jq for JSON transformations, object construction and scripted pipelines; Flik does not execute jq expressions.

Download synthetic JSON logs ↓
KUBERNETESInspect a live pod log stream

Pipe a Kubernetes log stream into Flik, then add filters and choose fields while new events arrive.

SHELL
kubectl logs -f deployment/demo-api | flik -

/ Search for timeout. Use Tab in the search prompt to complete fields and values, or w to expand embedded JSON when available.

Saved CRI-style log files are detected automatically. kubectl output is parsed according to the emitted application format.

Download a synthetic CRI log ↓
NGINXInvestigate failed requests and server errors
SHELL — ACCESS LOG
flik access.log

3 Apply status:5xx, then H for hourly counts. Use S for the HTTP status breakdown and frequent endpoints.

For an Nginx error log, open flik nginx-error.log. The statistics dashboard shows detected severity levels when no HTTP statuses are present.

Access log sample ↓Error log sample ↓
ERROR CONTEXTSee what happened before an error
TYPE IN THE MAIN LOG VIEW, THEN ENTER
//3,2:error

Shows each matching error, three preceding lines and two following lines. //error uses one preceding line. Context-only lines appear in gray.

Ctrl+G opens a larger context view around the selected result. Inside that view, n / p move between matches and Esc returns to the file.

Download synthetic events ↓
FREQUENCYCount a filtered error over time

First filter the error with /timeout, then press H for hourly counts. For another interval, open Ctrl+K and enter:

INVESTIGATION COMMAND
histogram minute

Also accepts histogram hour and histogram day. Counts use the active filters and exclude context-only lines. Results are UTC snapshots; close and rerun to refresh.

TRACES & CHANGEFollow a request or compare incident windows
SHELL — OPEN TWO FILES
flik api.log worker.log

In Ctrl+K, enter trace req-demo-42 to filter both sources and merge matching events chronologically. Existing filters remain active.

INVESTIGATION — 15 MINUTES BEFORE / AFTER
compare 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z 15

Use a timestamp from your log. compare files compares the two open sources. Changes describe observed patterns, not a proven cause.

KEYBOARD REFERENCE

Keyboard first.
Undo included.

Shortcuts are case-sensitive and apply to the main log view unless noted. Press 1 or ? for the in-app guide.

Investigation commands Open with Ctrl+K

Investigation command examples
CommandPurpose
context 20Show 20 lines before and after the selected result
time START..END / jump TIMEFilter a time range or jump to a timestamp (RFC3339)
around 5 / untimeWindow ±5 minutes around an event / remove the time filter
histogram minute|hour|dayCount matching events over time
compare TIME 15 / compare filesCompare equal time windows or the two open files
merge / trace req-demo-42Merge the filtered chronology / follow a request
save session.json / load session.jsonSave or restore files, filters, fields and positions
redact email,customer_idAdd extra field names to the built-in redaction keys
export incident.jsonlExport events with sources, original lines and context

Some terminals reserve Ctrl combinations; menu entries and function keys provide alternatives. Redaction is based on known keys and patterns; review incident exports before sharing.
